thesis: Jack Altman argues that founders must balance conviction against customer feedback, noting that while listening to customers is common advice, they often request features that do not align with the product's North Star vision. He emphasizes that sales conversations remain the most effective method for identifying product-market fit and understanding what truly resonates with customers, even when a sales team is already in place.
